scope: One authorized 24-candidate campaign; no production rollout and no automatic new campaign.
interface_coverage: 本轮开放固定机器顺序下的派工、准入排序、全线CONWIP与截止放行；未实现联合多机匹配和在线学习
isolation: Unprivileged Linux seccomp syscall allowlist in a fresh child; no filesystem access, network, exec/fork or process-memory access after code loading; no candidate source executes before lockdown.
resource_defaults: Calibrated on six exact reference replays; original defaults frozen before registration.
site_updates: Owner-private static snapshots at milestones; raw traces and private seed banks are not uploaded.
